purpose: Freeze two display-only structural signals: M3 x Ability v1 Top3 agreement and a front-running miss watch conditioned on the existing Race Shape bias layer. Neither changes M3, Ability, probabilities, market edge, QMD, or betting decisions.
universe: JRA flat, field size >=12, 3-win class or higher, using only pre-race information in the browser-equivalent reconstruction.

agreement_signal.rule: M3 rank <=3 AND Ability v1 rank <=3
agreement_signal.interpretation: Useful as a stable-axis candidate marker. The market already recognizes much of the strength, so this is not an automatic value or buy signal.

front_run_watch.base_rule: validated queue history AND frontness5 >=0.70 AND M3 rank >=4

bias_conditioning.interpretation: The ordering is directionally consistent with the proposed UI: flagged horses have the highest top3 rate in front-favouring races, intermediate in neutral races, and lowest in rear-chance races. However, race-cluster bootstrap intervals for front versus non-front cross zero, so this supports display-strength conditioning rather than a probability correction or standalone bet rule.

front_run_watch.interpretation: The queue layer often recognized the horse as forward-going, while the later M3 ranking still placed many eventual forward winners outside its Top3. Condition the warning strength on Race Shape rather than adding a front-running bonus to M3.

simple_bonus_test.note: A simple frontness>=0.70 bonus tuned on 2024 produced only trivial Top3-overlap change in 2025-2026 and was not stable enough to alter M3.

deployment_policy: Display only for races after the 2026-10-04 source cutoff.
Do not change M3 rank or M3 probabilities.
Do not change Ability v1/v2 rank or probabilities.
Do not change market Edge, QMD, ticket, or buy/no-buy logic.
Agreement marker uses Ability v1, not v2, because the primary agreement validation used the cleaner frozen independent v1 layer.
Front-run base rule requires ValidatedQueueState.validated=true so fallback-only horses are not flagged.
Race Shape front band => strong warning, neutral => weak caution, rear-chance => suppress the horse-level warning.
The bias-conditioned split is directional, not statistically resolved as an independent betting edge.
No ROI claim is established by either signal.
